This exact SHARE-pass hazard on an 8-lane vector_alu shape is already documented and fixed in pnr/asap7/gpu/config.json (memory: project_yosys_share_pass_hang.md, 'GPU ASAP7 synth hangs in yosys share SAT pass on 8-lane vector_alu shifters -- fix = patch librelane to gate share on SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES + set false in gpu config'), but was never propagated to this leaf-block config. valu_rtl/ and valu_hls/ are left untouched (per bead egt instructions) since their instance/area numbers reproduce the r8r baseline recorded in docs/CPP_TO_RTL_HLS_EVALUATION.md, i.e. SHARE did not corrupt those two structurally different (FSM / case-based) arms.
